summary.value: After Shibuya the jujutsu world is in disarray, and Itadori's execution is back on the table. A new game begins: players are sealed into colonies across Japan and must fight for points under a rulebook that keeps changing.
Itadori and Megumi set out to fight the game from the inside, while the Zenin clan's succession drags a family feud into the open.

events.title: Itadori's execution is reinstated
events.detail: Without Gojo to protect him, he becomes a target again.

events.title: The Zenin clan loses its head
events.detail: The succession is disputed, and the will names a successor the family does not expect.

events.title: Colonies are sealed
events.detail: Barriers close over colonies across Japan and players are pulled in.

events.title: Allies regroup
events.detail: Itadori, Megumi and their allies gather to prepare for the game.

events.title: Rules are announced
events.detail: Players learn they must score points by defeating one another.

events.title: Into the Tokyo No. 1 Colony
events.detail: Itadori and Megumi go in to find a player who can change the rules.

events.title: The fight moves to Sendai
events.detail: The Sendai Colony takes over the last chapters of Part 1.
